comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
More from tooling feedback (2026-10-09): pane p29te1jh5d, the one this card describes, still read `working` after about 41 hours and misled an integrator about machine load. A new plan-mode variant: the stale `working` followed the pane's own `msg post` just before its turn ended, and once cleared by itself after about a minute.

Unverified lead: `extras/claude-code/hooks/hooks.json` reports `working` on every PostToolUse and `idle` on Stop, with no ordering between them, so a slow PostToolUse report landing after Stop's would leave the pane `working`. The report's fix idea: decay `working`, or re-probe the pane after N minutes with no hook report and no screen change. Card `wakes-go-missing` depends on this: a receiver stuck at `working` is never rung.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-07/08 on the installed 0.13.0 app and daemon (pid 22427, ~/.muster/daemon/release.log). Two long-lived Claude Code panes in one tab - the integrator p29tc9yqkt and a worker p29te1jh5d - stopped producing daemon.agent.turn_ended after 04:08Z (worker's last at 04:08:42, integrator's at 03:56:55) while other panes on the same daemon kept producing it until 07:39Z. Both then read 'working' in muster window for 7+ hours while sitting at an empty prompt, their title glyph showing idle (✳).

The cost: the worker's 'done' message at 04:11:34Z was posted with deferred: muster-integrator (correctly - the integrator was mid-turn), and the deferred ring never fired, because the integrator never read idle again. Nothing re-rang, and the group-stall detection built the same night would not catch it either, since it only judges members that are not working. A whole parallel-work session sat stalled for 7 hours.

Not yet known: why the turn-end reports stopped for those two panes only (hook timing out under load, the plugin's hook failing, something else) - check the panes' hook output and the daemon's report handling. Things that might be true: the screen reading idle for minutes while the adapter last said working should win (or trigger a check), rather than the adapter's last word standing forever; and a deferred ring could have a ceiling after which it rings regardless and logs why.
title: A Claude pane whose turn-end report is lost reads working forever, and its messages wait with it
